title: Generative AI and Jobs: A Refined Global Index of Occupational Exposure
method_note: Task-level methodology drawing on 29,753 tasks in the Polish occupational classification, human survey/expert input and AI predictions, mapped to international occupations.
use: Global exposure, exposure gradients, transformation-vs-replacement framing.

title: Generative AI at Work
method_note: Staggered introduction of an AI conversational assistant to 5,179 customer-support agents.

title: Still Waters, Rapid Currents: Early Labor Market Transformation under Generative AI
method_note: Links large-scale chatbot-adoption surveys to administrative labour-market records; difference-in-differences.
use: Task reorganisation; earnings/hours null effects within two years.

title: 2026 Global AI Jobs Barometer
method_note: Analysis of more than one billion job ads plus company-level productivity/headcount analysis.
use: AI-skill wage premium, junior-role seniorisation, professionalised vs democratised roles.

title: Canaries in the Coal Mine? Six Facts about the Recent Employment Effects of Artificial Intelligence
method_note: ADP high-frequency administrative payroll data covering millions of US workers through June 2026.
use: Young-worker employment patterns by AI exposure; no economy-wide displacement finding.

title: Young people, labour markets and AI: What OECD evidence shows
method_note: OECD interpretation of youth labour-market evidence and AI-related evidence.
use: Caveat against attributing the broad youth-employment slowdown to AI.

title: Future of Jobs Report 2025
method_note: Survey of more than 1,000 employers representing over 14 million workers.
use: Skills change, training needs, employer-reported barriers and responses.

title: India: 2024 Article IV Consultation — Annex XIV: The Impacts of AI on India's Economy
method_note: India country assessment applying IMF AI-exposure framework and labour-force structure.

title: Advancing India’s AI Skills: Interventions and Programmes Needed
method_note: Industry-focused skills/talent outlook; not representative of the entire Indian workforce.
use: AI talent pool and AI-market growth estimates.

title: WORK REIMAGINED: The Rise of Human–AI Collaboration
method_note: Indian technology-industry evidence; do not generalise to all Indian workers.
use: Human–AI collaboration and reported share of work using AI.

title: Generative AI at work: What it means for jobs in Europe and beyond
type: Nationally representative worker survey + focus groups
method_note: Focus groups with workers/managers plus nationally representative workplace adoption survey.
use: Qualitative themes: verification, skill erosion concerns, consultation, governance gaps.

title: The impact of GenAI on jobs, productivity and work organization: a review of the empirical evidence
method_note: Review of experiments, firm data, platform studies and representative surveys.
use: Synthesis: productivity gains uneven; large-scale displacement limited; job-quality and young-worker risks.
